question: Who among the following wrote the book 'Long Walk to Freedom'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nelson Mandela**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nelson Mandela** wrote the book 'Long Walk to Freedom'.
 
• The book is an autobiography chronicling his early life, coming of age, education, and 27 years in prison.
 
• 'Long Walk to Freedom' was first published in **1994**.
 
• It provides a detailed account of Mandela's role in the struggle
